exerciseErrorRows.issue: Crunch is a dynamic spinal flexion movement, not isometric.
Surfing involves dynamic balance and paddling/pop-up movements, not purely isometric; could be classified as dynamic-mobility or gait instead.
Hip thrust is generally considered a compound movement (hip extension involving glutes, hamstrings, core), not isolation.
Battle rope circles are a rhythmic conditioning exercise, better classified under dynamic upper-body cardio rather than dynamic-mobility (which typically refers to ROM drills like leg swings).
Conan's Wheel requires a specialized strongman wheel/yoke implement, not 'none'
Tire flip is a compound hinge/squat-based lifting movement, not a plyometric explosive jump/throw exercise.
Scissor kicks are a controlled core strength/isolation exercise, not a dynamic-mobility drill.
